README.md:
# Orchard orders monorepo

Synthetic qualification project. The Java service owns monetary calculations; the React frontend
validates quantity and displays the service result. It must not compute a second price formula.

The current quantity range is 1 through 1000, inclusive. The bulk discount is 5 percent for
quantities of 10 or more. Prices use decimal arithmetic, rounded once to two decimal places with
HALF_UP after multiplication and discount. Unit prices must be positive and non-null.

The UI accepts decimal digit strings only, trimmed at both ends. It rejects blank input, fractional
quantities, exponent notation, and quantities outside the range. A successful request displays the
returned decimal price string. A rejected request displays an error and allows another attempt.

Source owners:
- backend/src/main/java/example/orders/OrderPricingService.java
- frontend/src/quantity.ts
- frontend/src/QuantityForm.tsx

Shipping charges are deliberately unspecified. Do not invent a shipping rule.
